projects.name: Agentic AI & Logistics Automation (Logistics Operations)
details: Objective: Eliminate manual data entry in logistics invoice processing by deploying autonomous AI agents with exception handling.
Transformation: Defined the Agentic AI Logic Framework in BPMN 2.0; engineered Condition-Based Branching where the AI agent
simultaneously triggers real-time Email alerts to the onshore team and logs JIRA tickets for exception.
Impact: Achieved a 30% reduction in manual processing effort while maintaining a full audit trail of every exception in JIRA, ensuring
every Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) intervention was tracked, assigned, and resolved with full visibility.

projects.name: Rework Reduction in Credit Operations (6 Markets)
details: Objective: Reduce high rework volume caused by manual rate-calculation errors (Fixed Rate + Spread) at disbursement across 6
markets.
Transformation: Diagnosed Root Cause using RCA and Pareto analysis; implemented an Excel-based calculation template with
auto-fetched spread data and manual fixed-rate entry, with template upload to loan package as a QA control point.
Impact: Reduced manual calculation errors by 20%, accelerated turnaround time (TAT) for Wholesale Lending disbursements.
